name: How long does drywall and finish work take in a new room addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does drywall and finish work take in a new room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an average room addition, drywall hanging, taping, mudding, sanding, and priming typically take 5 to 10 working days. The schedule depends heavily on the size of the space and compound drying conditions. Multiple coats of joint compound must dry completely before sanding and recoating, which can take longer during damp or cold weather. Once the final sanding passes inspection, applying drywall primer seals the paper and compound, making the surfaces ready for interior paint, baseboards, and window trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall hanging, taping, multi-coat mudding, and sanding typically take 5 to 10 days for an average room addition, depending on room size and humidity drying times.
